profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer, AI @ Tanium, MSCS @ UT Austin, Tech Speaker
profile.summary:
I enjoy building software with a practical approach, focusing on customer needs and using data insights to guide development. I believe in the importance of continuous improvement and refining solutions iteratively, and have a passion for prototyping and experimenting with new technologies and concepts.

I have experience in full-stack TypeScript development, including UI development with React, microfrontend development using the Piral framework, and scaffolding and managing JS/TS monorepos. I have worked extensively with the Serverless Framework and am adept in unit and integration testing using Jest, React Testing Library, and Playwright on both the frontend and backend.

Beyond full-stack JavaScript, I have experience developeing backend HTTP microservices using Golang and Python (ASGI), instrumenting Generative AI services with OpenTelemetry, and building a governance-first MLOps platform for ShareFile. My daily work includes interacting with various AWS services, including SageMaker, S3, Secrets Manager, Lambda, DynamoDB, SSM, CloudWatch, and CloudTrail.

In my free time, I contribute to open-source projects, experiment with new technologies through personal projects, and deliver tech talks and workshops. I also help run GDG Chapel Hill, a local developer community in Chapel Hill, NC, where we share knowledge and collaborate on various tech topics.

More about me: https://aanpatel.tech

positions.title: Software Engineer 2, Automated Workflows and Vertical Solution Packages team (ShareFile)
positions.description:
Helping SMBs win with automated workflows and a solutions marketplace at ShareFile (a Business Unit of Cloud Software Group, formerly Citrix).

Developing and maintaining a boxes-and-arrows workflow designer, a workflow engine built on top of an open-source orchestration platform, a generic service that enables "save as template" on anything within the app, and a solution marketplace.

Frequent exposure to AWS Serverless Framework, TypeScript, React, Piral Micro-frontend Framework, Temporal.io (microservice orchestrator), and Kubernetes.

Notable contributions: (1) developed a graph auto-layout algorithm for the boxes-and-arrows workflow designer, (2) designed and implemented a debugger tool for a headless library that handles workflow DSL editing (resulting in expedited bug fixes and feature delivery for the workflow designer), (3) proposed and implemented a TypeScript monorepository solution with build parallelization to manage common source code across 3 microservices (supporting 20+ shared libraries at the moment).

positions.title: Software Engineer - Workspace Integrations team
positions.description:
Building the future of work collaboration with Integrations for Citrix Workspace.

Developing an Integration Platform backed by a C#/.NET + MS SQL Server microservice running on Kubernetes with React on the front-end.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
• Delivered an end-to-end “Unified Recent Files” feature with expected 25,000+ monthly active users for the Citrix Workspace application to enable users to access all of their recent files from any number of file storage providers from one screen.

• Designed, implemented, and deployed the following feature components in the process:
1. Two Node.JS integrations (back-end plugins) for the proprietary “Citrix Workspace Integration Platform” to retrieve a list of recent files along with file activity information from (1) OneDrive or SharePoint online, and (2) Google Drive. Configured and leveraged industry-standard JavaScript technologies for both integrations, including Babel, Webpack, and ESLint. Implemented unit tests using Jest with 100% coverage.

2. A microservice API for Citrix Workspace in C#, .NET Core to aggregate the responses from the “recent files” integrations. Implemented unit tests with XUnit. Configured the CI/CD pipeline using Jenkins. Leveraged modern technologies including Docker, Kubernetes (Helm), and Terraform, for deployment to Microsoft Azure.

3. A Citrix Workspace user interface page for “Unified Recent Files” using React with TypeScript and Jest with Enzyme for testing.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · React · Web Development · Software Engineering · Data Structures · Algorithms · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS)

positions.title: Virtual Tech Camp Instructor
positions.description:
Delivered top-notch STEM education by teaching Minecraft Modding using Java, Python for Data Science, and C++ for batches of 4-5 students ages 7-19 every workday for 2-3 sessions of 2.5 hours each.

Guided clients with installation and troubleshooting every weekend before the start of next week’s camps (usual workload - 300+ clients handled by 20-25 employees), to improve and smoothen their “first day of camp” experience.
positions.insights: Skills: Machine Learning · Data Structures · Algorithms

positions.title: Full-Stack Web Developer Intern
positions.description:
Architected, designed, and implemented the following web applications from front to back using Bootstrap, jQuery, PHP, and MySQL, to grow the startup's projects portfolio by 22%:
1. An e-learning website – orionpublication.com, with the following features:
 ‎‎‎• Google OAuth 2.0 Login and Signup
 • A complete content management dashboard for instructors allowing them to:
  (i) Create courses
  (ii) Add video lectures
  (iii) PDF/other file resources
  (iv) Create quizzes for courses
  (v) Manage Q&A with students on each course
 • A complete dashboard for students allowing them to:
  (i) Search for, and enroll into courses
  (ii) Manage their courses, certifications and enrollments.
  (iv) Access course video lectures.
  (v) Track course progress
  (vi) Take secure quizzes for courses (Quiz module features random option shuffling).
  (vii) Access auto-generated verifiable PDF certificates.

2. A freelance search-and-hire website, BizLancer, with the following features:
 • A complete workflow implementation for employers allowing them to:
  (i) Create job postings
  (ii) Shortlist applicants
  (iii) Hire applicants
  (iv) Chat in real-time (uses AJAX) with applicants
 • A complete dashboard for applicants allowing them to:
  (i) Search for, and apply to job postings
  (ii) Manage their profile, which includes education, experience, skills, certifications, known languages, a profile photo and much more.

Co-developed the following modules with senior developer:
 1. A back-end payment gateway for a footwear e-commerce website for a client
 2. Memo and Reminder module for BizAssist – a business administration solution currently used 
          in-house

See it in action: https://youtu.be/v3-rxq5u9iY
